note: Indicative Pakistani market rates (September 2026), built up from published 2026 material prices for cement (~PKR 1,500/50kg bag), Grade-60 steel (~PKR 280-300/kg), sand (~PKR 55-70/cft), crush/bajri (~PKR 110-150/cft), bricks (~PKR 14-17/unit), plaster (~PKR 64-125/sqft incl. labour), paint (~PKR 25-70/sqft incl. labour), wooden doors with frame (~PKR 25,000-30,000/door mid-range) and aluminium windows (~PKR 1,500-2,500/sqft), combined with standard nominal-mix (cement:sand:aggregate) and dry-volume-factor quantities plus typical site labour allowances. All rates are all-inclusive (material + labour) approximations for preliminary budgeting ONLY - they are NOT a live price feed, are NOT city/supplier-specific (Karachi/Lahore/Islamabad and rural rates can differ by 10-30%), and MUST be overridden with your own current local quotations before the cost estimate is relied upon. Every rate below is per canonical metric unit (m3/m2/kg) even when the app is displaying quantities in FPS (cft/sqft) - the on-screen rate is converted automatically so totals match either way. The cement/sand/aggregate breakdown shown in the MTO (Step 4) for every concrete/mortar pour is a procurement-reference quantity only - it is already included in that pour's composite rate below (e.g. FTG-CONC-01) and deliberately has NO rate-book entry of its own, so it is never double-counted in the BOQ.
